urls.title: Company websites
urls.description: Domains or URLs to enrich, e.g. "acme.com" or "https://www.acme.com". Duplicates are removed.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Pages per website
maxPagesPerSite.description: Homepage plus the most relevant contact/about/imprint/team pages. More pages find more contacts but take longer. The price per website is the same.

includeTechnologies.title: Detect tech stack
includeTechnologies.description: Detect the technologies behind each website (CMS, e-commerce platform, analytics, CRM…) using 7,600+ fingerprints.

minConfidence.title: Tech detection: minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Only report technologies detected with at least this confidence (0–100).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many websites to process in parallel.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per page (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a page after this many seconds. Websites whose homepage can't be loaded are not charged.
